chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Al-As, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the cheetahs and birds of prey, is trade sought in them? He said, 'Yes.'

key_terms.سِبَاعِ الطَّيْرِ: Birds of prey (lions of the sky, referring to eagles, hawks, etc.)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy and sell cheetahs and birds of prey in Islamic jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) validates the commercial trade of cheetahs and birds of prey, establishing them as valid commodities (*mal*) within Islamic jurisprudence. This ruling is particularly significant in the context of *al-Gharar* (uncertainty), as it clarifies that despite the potential unpredictability of wild animals, their trade is permissible provided the essential elements of the contract are met, reflecting the practical economic realities of the early Shia community.
